explicit_boundaries: 16 confirmed defects are not 29 confirmed application bugs; confirmed categories are 11 application/content,1 iOS build,3 latent release and1 test-registration.
MF-C1 aliases M-C01. Ten omitted descriptors are one ROOT-T3 cause, separate from SN-T1 fixture design. Four content chronology manifestations are one WD-C2.
WD-C2 age-order/Zamalek duration siblings remain unconfirmed; M-C03 setup/tally hypotheses remain unconfirmed; ROOT-C1 post-open native exception uncertainty is not silently promoted.
IOS-R1 observed app banner is real but original KMP failure remains unattributed. The separate -34018 native probe is counter-evidence, not diagnosis of original app or signed-device behavior.
WD-C4 ticker removal/resumption is corroborated but modal-clock product policy remains unresolved; no severity or positive count.
ST-C1 actual K/N Foundation witnesses are2PASS/1expectedFAIL, not3safety passes, crypto/Keychain round trips, real backup evidence or a fix.
ROOT-T3 eight enabled wrapper bodies passed; normal discovery remains unfixed and two ignored physical bodies never ran.
Runtime/reproducer status belongs to existing root-owned receipts. This reviewer did not run builds/tests/devices/signing/Store operations in this reconciliation.
No amount of index/dossier reconciliation establishes new source coverage, absence of other defects, GitHub open/closed counts, fixes or Store readiness.
